english.title: Make a disclosure likely to prejudice an investigation into potential contravention of relevant requirement
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), made a disclosure, namely **(..SPECIFY DISCLOSURE..) that was being or about to be conducted specified in Schedule 6 to the Money Laundering Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017, knowing or suspecting that an appropriate officer was acting or proposing to act in an investigation into that potential contravention
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 87(2)(a) of the Money Laundering Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
made a disclosure that was being / or about to be conducted
specified in Schedule 6 to the Money Laundering Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017
knowing / suspecting that an appropriate officer was acting / proposing to act in an investigation into that potential contravention

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) See defence in regulation 87(3) , whereby a person not guilty of this offence: if they didn't know or suspect the disclosure was likely to prejudice the investigation; they made the disclosure in the exercise of a function imposed by or under these Regulations, the Terrorism Act 2000, or the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, or any other Act relating to criminal document or benefit from criminal conduct; or, they are a professional legal adviser and the disclosure is to a client or any person in connection with legal proceedings.

other.penalty:

INDICTMENT: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:
